title: MZ Harold's AI Odyssey II [Harold Game Jam 2025]

posts.author: Frogboy
posts.body:
Harold’s AI Odyssey II: A Journey Through Time
A hand-drawn, point‑and‑click RPG where history, art, and game-jam drama collide.
✦ What Am I Getting Myself Into?
Harold’s AI Odyssey II
is a micro‑JRPG / point‑and‑click hybrid built in RPG Maker MZ with
masterfully AI-generated art
kindergarten-level MS Paint art (absolutely zero generative‑AI assets).
You’ll travel through five stages throughout history - Paleolithic, Ancient Egypt, Renaissance, the Victorian age, and the Modern era - in a race against time to restore technologies that advanced the world of art and creativity.
✦ Gameplay at a Glance
Technology has been wiped from the face of the Earth. That means no default RPG Maker mechanics whatsoever. No tiles, no scrolling, no default battle system - nothing.
Harold's AI Odyssey II
takes you back to a simpler time when game technology was more primitive… yet still deeply fun.
Every part of this game is scripted and evented into something totally unrecognizable from RPG Maker. Enjoy an original battle system where you target attacks on a 3×3 enemy grid, finding each enemy's weak points. Find archaeological relics and discover when and where to use them to progress.
✦ A Very Quick Story Recap
Last time, Harold destroyed an evil rogue AI. This time? They’re reluctant allies.
When the global ban on AI technology fractures time itself, Harold and his former nemesis must journey through human history to reignite the creative spark - before all of art and invention vanish forever.
✦ Unique Features
Crayon-core visual style: Every asset is lovingly MS-Painted by hand
Memorization-based combat: No grinding - just pattern recognition and adaptation
Point-and-click overworld: Navigate static screens like an old-school adventure game
Era-themed puzzles: Use items where they historically matter
Learn how history and technology shaped human creativity and expression
Infinite replayability: Items are randomly placed and enemy defenses shift every run
A story that seriously (and hilariously) explores AI's place in creative culture
✦ Are You Game?
Playtime:
20 – 60 minutes
Engine:
RPG Maker MZ
No plugins used:
All scripting and eventing by Frogboy
Special thanks:
The Harold Jam community
